Schema-backed demo venue

Synthetic dev fixture validated by BuildingLayout schema v2, then adapted through decodeLayout. It is not a measured or customer venue. Supported source fields shown here: 2 floors, 4 room records, 1 abstract portals, 6 adapted floor objects, 2 authored instances, 2 authored walls and 2 wall openings. The rendered floor has no underlay image; boundaries, walkable zones, booths, and portal entry points come from supported schema fields.

Role access is a lab-local explicit allow-list. BuildingLayout has no role ACL or per-zone visibility field; this does not demonstrate venue security.
